text:
Release Bot: post-deploy synth smoke for rollout v2026.04.01 completed. overall green but embed route had a latency thrum in us-central. dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/3915000000
Elena: seeing periodic 504s for /embed/vectorize when seq>1024, spike at 11:07UTC (us-central). small blast radius (~6 hosts).
deploy-bot: synth-smoke: embed-vectorize-check -> 504 upstream-timeout on 6 hosts (us-central) retry queued.
Kai: i'm on-call for us-central. checking logs now — failures aligned with requests using model_variant=vq-8bit and token_length > 1024.
QA Bot: log snippet:
```
POST /embed/vectorize 504 {"error":"upstream-timeout"} variant=vq-8bit seq_len=1536 host=10.20.7.12
trace_id=tr-2026-04-01-110712
```
Platform Eng: quick note — runtime kernel selector change for quantized variants shipped in v2026.04.01 to pick new matmul kernel. Under long sequences we saw occasional convoying on the GPU leading to tail latency.
Elena: prefer targeted mitigation, not rollback. Proposal: pin /embed/vectorize in us-central to v2026.03.29 and disable quantize_override=true on v2026.04.01, then rerun smoke.
deploy-bot: executing: `redwood route pin --route /embed/vectorize --to v2026.03.29 --region us-central`
deploy-bot: pin applied. Traffic to v2026.03.29 in us-central. :white_check_mark:
QA Bot: feature flag quantize_override=false toggled on v2026.04.01. kicking off synth rerun (id ss-3915000000-2).
deploy-bot: synth rerun complete: 200/200 checks OK, p95=48ms, no 5xx.
Kai: leaving pin for 40m to collect traces and client error budgets. will follow up with a kernel fallback patch to throttle concurrent long-seq infer.
Platform Eng: filing INF-10002 "quant-kernel convoying long-seq tail" and attaching traces + replay. plan a performance patch and a canary for kernel selector.
Release Bot: rollout hold set for 40m. Notifying #deploy-notify.
Elena: thanks everyone — re-enable quantize_override with a 5% canary after patch if metrics look stable. :thumbsup:
